title: The tech of 'Terminator 2' – an oral history (2017)
summary: An oral history exploring the groundbreaking visual effects technology behind Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991), focusing on how ILM created the revolutionary T-1000 liquid metal character using morphing, digital compositing, and practical effects combined with CGI.
problem_solved: How to convincingly portray a shape-shifting liquid metal assassin (T-1000) using 1991 technology, pushing the boundaries of what was visually possible in cinema.
why_valuable: Terminator 2's VFX innovations, particularly the T-1000, fundamentally changed filmmaking and established techniques that still influence visual effects today.
